title: Eventual equality of differential ranks under a finite field extension
statement: Let $p$ be prime, let $K$ be a field of characteristic $p$, and let $L/K$ be a finite field extension [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Let $(K_\alpha)_{\alpha\in I}$ be a nonempty family of subfields of $K$ such that $[K:K_\alpha]<\infty$ for every $\alpha$, $\bigcap_{\alpha\in I}K_\alpha=K^p=\{x^p:x\in K\}$, and for every $\alpha,\beta\in I$ some $\gamma\in I$ satisfies $K_\gamma\subseteq K_\alpha\cap K_\beta$. Then there exists $\beta\in I$ such that for every subfield $K\prime\subseteq K_\beta$ with $[K:K\prime]<\infty$, one has $\dim_L\Omega_{L/K\prime}=\dim_K\Omega_{K/K\prime}$, where $\Omega$ denotes Kähler differentials [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials].

source.place: Expose IV Proposition 1.2.4 (Matsumura stabilization), printed p.49; proof using IV 1.2.1–1.2.3, printed pp.48–49.
